svg.title: OpenAlgo Charts 2.1.8 architecture
svg.desc: OpenAlgo Charts 2.1.8. Custom hosts or the widget use seven capability layers, with per-pane base and overlay canvases, optional WebGL2 series rendering, drawing model v2, compact TPO, per-session split, open/latest-close markers and grouped depth. Indicator and profile calculations run on the CPU. Eight bundle tiers: base 74.00 KB, widget 41.59 KB, indicators 28.05 KB, draw 25.90 KB, profile 14.96 KB, trade 7.61 KB, webgl 6.38 KB, transform 2.66 KB, everything 201.15 KB Brotli.
svg.text: any host can register its own

text.tspan: any host can register its own with the same descriptor contract the 102 built-ins use.

svg.text: Indicator / profile calculations: CPU. WebGL2 accelerates supported series drawing.
